### Remote Work Policy – Revoking Arrangements
According to the remote work policy, arrangements **may be modified or revoked at any time** if availability, communication, or performance expectations are not being met. When this occurs, managers are required to:

1. **Document any concerns**, and
2. Provide a **30-day improvement window** before revoking the arrangement

> ⚠️ **Important Exception:** The 30-day improvement window does **not** apply in cases of a **security policy violation** — arrangements can be revoked **immediately** in those situations.

- *Source: Retrieval Agent, sourced from `remote-work-policy.pdf` (Sources 1 & 2)*
